clauses.title: Specified Critical Illnesses and Surgical Procedures
clauses.text: 1.1Specified Critical Illnesses and Surgical Procedures The Insured Event under this Section I and the conditions applicable to the same are more particularly defined below:

clauses.title: Cancer of specified severity
clauses.text: 1.Cancer of specified severity A malignant tumour characterised by the uncontrolled growth & spread of malignant cells with invasion & destruction of normal tissues. This diagnosis must be supported by histological evidence of malignancy. The term cancer includes leukemia, lymphoma and sarcoma. The following are excluded –

clauses.title: All tumours which are histologically described as carcinoma in situ, benign, borderline
clauses.text: i.All tumours which are histologically described as carcinoma in situ, benign, borderline malignant, low malignant potential, neoplasm of unknown behavior or non-invasive, including but not limited to: Carcinoma in situ of breasts, Cervical dysplasia CIN-1, CIN -2 & CIN-3.

clauses.title: Any non-melanoma skin carcinoma unless there is evidence of metastases to lymph nodes
clauses.text: ii.Any non-melanoma skin carcinoma unless there is evidence of metastases to lymph nodes or beyond;

clauses.title: Malignant melanoma that has not caused invasion beyond the epidermis All tumours of
clauses.text: iii.Malignant melanoma that has not caused invasion beyond the epidermis All tumours of the prostate unless histological classified as having a Gleason score greater than 6 or having progressed to at least clinical TNM classification T2NOMO

clauses.title: All Thyroid cancers histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM Classification) or below;
clauses.text: iv.All Thyroid cancers histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM Classification) or below;

clauses.title: Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia less than RAI stage 3
clauses.text: v.Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia less than RAI stage 3

clauses.title: Non-invasive papillary cancer of the bladder histologically described as TaN0M0 or of a
clauses.text: vi.Non-invasive papillary cancer of the bladder histologically described as TaN0M0 or of a lesser classification,

clauses.title: All Gastro-Intestinal Stromal Tumors histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM
clauses.text: vii.All Gastro-Intestinal Stromal Tumors histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM Classification) or below and with mitotic count of less than or equal to 5/50 HPFs.

clauses.title: All tumours in the presence of HIV infection
clauses.text: viii.All tumours in the presence of HIV infection

clauses.text: 5.Coma of Specified Severity A state of unconsciousness with no reaction or response to external stimuli or internal needs. This diagnosis must be supported by evidence of all of the following:

clauses.title: No response to external stimuli continuously for at least 96 hours;
clauses.text: i.No response to external stimuli continuously for at least 96 hours;

clauses.title: Life support measures are necessary to sustain life; and
clauses.text: ii.Life support measures are necessary to sustain life; and

clauses.text: iii.Permanent neurological deficit which must be assessed at least 30 days after the onset of the coma. The condition has to be confirmed by a specialist Medical Practitioner. Coma resulting directly from alcohol or drug abuse is excluded.

clauses.title: Kidney Failure requiring regular dialysis
clauses.text: 6.Kidney Failure requiring regular dialysis End stage renal disease presenting as chronic irreversible failure of both kidneys to function, as a result of which either regular renal dialysis (haemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis) is instituted or renal transplantation is carried out. Diagnosis has to be confirmed by a specialist Medical Practitioner.

clauses.title: Stroke resulting in permanent symptoms
clauses.text: 7.Stroke resulting in permanent symptoms Any cerebrovascular incident producing permanent neurological sequelae. This includes infarction of brain tissue, thrombosis in an intracranial vessel, haemorrhage and embolization from an extra cranial source. Diagnosis has to be confirmed by a specialist Medical Practitioner and evidenced by typical clinical symptoms as well as typical findings in CT Scan or MRI of the brain.
